courtViewDefinition: same badminton court-view definition as the other broadcasts. This is a basketball broadcast: no frame in the window is a badminton court view, so courtView is empty by construction and every positive prediction on this broadcast is a false positive.
notes: NEGATIVE broadcast. Included because an indoor basketball court is the hardest available negative for a line-based court-view rule: a large bright wooden floor with many long, high-contrast straight painted lines, shot from a wide elevated camera - exactly the feature signature a badminton court produces. The E1 measurement on this broadcast is pure specificity. The scene-change ground truth is deliberately left empty and marked incomplete: a highlights package cuts faster than the 0.5 s marking rate can resolve, so this broadcast is reported for E2 context only and is excluded from the E2 recall/false-rate gate (the gate's false-event budget is defined per 60 s of continuous court view, of which this broadcast has none). The 42 scene changes used for this broadcast come entirely from the candidate-verification pass (probe/corpus/verified/negative-basketball.json); no independent hand-marked scene-change list exists for it, so its E2 recall is reported for context only.
